facts.text: Cheeca Lodge & Spa is a 27-acre oceanfront resort in Islamorada.
facts.excerpt: within the embrace of our 27-acre oceanfront Islamorada resort

facts.text: Cheeca Lodge & Spa has been in Islamorada since 1946.
facts.excerpt: Since 1946, Cheeca Lodge & Spa has set the standard of luxury in Islamorada

facts.text: The premier oceanfront suites have unobstructed views of the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Cheeca’s new luxury oceanfront suites offer spectacular, unobstructed views of the Atlantic Ocean.

facts.excerpt: embarking on a kayaking adventure along the picturesque coast, or taking a plunge into the depths with a scuba excursion
